超写实豪华私人飞机舱内写真，横版约 4:3。三名明确成年的东亚女性，20+，穿统一的空乘主题泳装，在私人飞机客舱内为镜头庆祝举杯。采用 24–28mm 广角镜头近距离拍摄，前景人物距离镜头最近，形成明显近大远小透视，另外两人依次分布在中景和右后方。

三人均为自然丰满偏沙漏型身材，肩部适中，胸部丰满，腰部收束，髋部圆润，大腿匀称，不要纸片身材，也不要夸张健美感。

前景女性位于画面左侧，身体前倾靠近镜头，露出灿烂笑容，右手将一只装有金色起泡酒的细长香槟杯递向镜头，杯子因距离最近而明显放大。她留深棕色中长发，松散盘起并带薄碎刘海。

中景女性站在过道中央，身体略向前弯，双手端着一只银色圆形托盘，托盘上摆放葡萄、草莓、橄榄和精致小甜点，面带微笑看向镜头。

右后方第三名女性背对镜头站在酒水柜旁，身体略侧转，正在拿取或倒香槟，只露出侧脸与背部轮廓。

三人统一穿深藏蓝＋白色滚边的空乘主题比基尼套装：三角形上衣、低腰泳裤，胸前可有小型金色翅膀徽章；颈部系蓝白条纹丝巾，头戴小巧藏蓝色空乘帽，帽侧带金色翅膀图案。整体是明显的时尚 Cosplay / 派对主题，不是真实航空制服。

场景为豪华私人公务机内部：奶油白真皮座椅、抛光深棕木饰面桌板、黑色高光柜体、金属装饰条，左侧连续椭圆形舷窗外可见高空蓝天和云层。顶部有暖白色隐藏灯带，客舱纵深明显。

右侧桌面摆放香槟冰桶、香槟瓶、多个高脚杯、黑紫葡萄、草莓、水果拼盘、精致小食和甜点，增强私人派对氛围。后方屏幕可显示简洁的蓝色欢迎界面与飞机图形，不需要准确文字。

光线为明亮柔和的机舱暖光＋舷窗自然日光，肤色自然暖白，香槟、金属冰桶和木饰面有真实反光。整体呈高质量商业摄影与轻微生活抓拍结合的质感，画面清晰、通透、奢华但不失真实。

promptTranslations.en: Ultra-realistic photoshoot inside a luxury private jet cabin, horizontal orientation around 4:3. Three clearly adult East Asian women, 20+, wearing matching flight attendant-themed swimwear, celebrating and raising a toast to the camera inside a private jet cabin. Shot up close with a 24–28mm wide-angle lens; the foreground subject is closest to the camera, creating a pronounced near-large-far-small perspective, with the other two distributed sequentially in the mid-ground and right background. All three have naturally curvy, hourglass-leaning figures with moderate shoulders, full busts, tapered waists, rounded hips, and well-proportioned thighs—neither paper-thin nor exaggeratedly athletic. The foreground woman is on the left side of the frame, leaning forward toward the camera with a radiant smile, extending a slender champagne flute filled with golden sparkling wine right toward the lens with her right hand, the glass noticeably enlarged due to its close proximity. She has deep brown medium-long hair loosely pinned up with wispy bangs. The mid-ground woman stands in the center of the aisle, leaning slightly forward, holding a silver round tray with both hands loaded with grapes, strawberries, olives, and delicate pastries, smiling toward the camera. The third woman in the right background stands near the bar cabinet with her back to the camera, turning slightly to the side as she retrieves or pours champagne, showing only her profile and the contours of her back. All three wear matching navy blue with white trim flight attendant-themed bikini sets: triangle tops and low-rise bottoms, optionally with small gold wing emblems on the chest; blue-and-white striped silk scarves tied around their necks, and small navy flight attendant caps with gold wing motifs on the side. The overall aesthetic is distinctly high-fashion cosplay / party-themed, not real airline uniforms. The scene is set inside a luxury private business jet interior: creamy white leather seats, polished dark brown wood veneer tables, high-gloss black cabinets, metal trim accents, and consecutive oval cabin windows on the left showing high-altitude blue skies and clouds outside. Warm white recessed light strips line the ceiling, creating prominent cabin depth. The table on the right holds an ice bucket with champagne, champagne bottles, multiple stemmed glasses, dark purple grapes, strawberries, a fruit platter, gourmet hors d'oeuvres, and pastries, enhancing the private party atmosphere. A screen in the background can show a clean blue welcome interface with an airplane graphic, without precise text required. The lighting combines bright, soft warm cabin light with natural daylight from the windows, yielding naturally warm white skin tones, with realistic reflections on the champagne, metallic ice bucket, and wooden veneers. The overall aesthetic blends high-end commercial photography with a candid lifestyle snapshot—clear, transparent, luxurious, yet grounded in realism. Key focus: three adult East Asian women + private jet cabin + matching blue-and-white flight attendant-themed bikinis + blue-and-white silk scarves + flight attendant caps + foreground woman holding champagne flute close to camera + mid-ground woman holding fruit and dessert tray + right background woman facing away at bar cabinet + champagne ice bucket + cream white seats + dark wood veneers + window clouds + 24–28mm wide-angle close-up perspective. Avoid: real airline logos, actual flight attendant uniforms, minors, incorrect number of people, long dresses, professional business suits, commercial airliner economy cabin, nightclub background, heavy cakey makeup, anime faces, CG plastic look, merged limbs, extra fingers, extra people, watermarks, and garbled text.

summaryTranslations.en: Ultra-realistic photoshoot inside a luxury private jet cabin, featuring three young East Asian women in flight attendant-themed bikinis raising a toast, with a wide-angle close-up composition showcasing foreground champagne, a mid-ground fruit platter, and luxurious cabin details.
